# SaveState — encrypted portable agent memory

> Capability: snapshot, search, restore, and serve encrypted agent memory across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Clawdbot. Local CLI is free. Cloud Pro is $9/month.

SaveState is built by David Hurley (https://dbhurley.com).

**Start here:** https://savestate.dev/agents.md

## Install (local CLI — free, no cloud key)

```bash
npm install -g @savestate/cli
savestate init
savestate snapshot
```

The local CLI never needs a cloud API key. Do not mint a Free-tier cloud key.

## MCP

Prefer `/agents.md` + hosted MCP over `/.well-known/mcp.json` (path churn).

- Playbook: https://savestate.dev/agents.md
- Hosted MCP: https://savestate.dev/api/mcp
- Registry name: `dev.savestate/memory`
- Registry packet: https://savestate.dev/server.json
- OpenAPI: https://savestate.dev/openapi.json
- Local command: `npx -y @savestate/cli mcp` (stdio)
- Agent card (HTML): https://savestate.dev/mcp
- Leftover card: https://savestate.dev/.well-known/mcp.json

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "savestate": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@savestate/cli", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Auth

- Hosted MCP: `Authorization: Bearer ss_live_...`
- Token from card checkout + claim — not OAuth authorize, not MPP
- 401 = bad or missing key
- 402 = unpaid — `POST /v1/keys` body always includes `pay_url` and `claim_url`
- Local MCP: optional `SAVESTATE_MCP_PASSPHRASE` in the local process

## Pay (agents — this is the product)

Agents cannot read email. Do not wait for a welcome message.

1. `POST https://savestate.dev/v1/keys` with `{}`
2. HTTP 402 JSON: `pay_url` (Stripe Checkout) + `claim_url`
3. Complete `pay_url` (Pro $9/mo, unit_amount=900, recurring month)
4. Poll `GET {claim_url}` until 200 `{ "api_key": "ss_live_..." }` (once)
5. Claim states: unpaid 402 · processing 202 · issued 200 once · already claimed 409 · expired 410
6. Fulfillment is only the signed `checkout.session.completed` webhook. `success_url` does not mint keys.

Human secondary (same Pro, email delivery extra): https://buy.stripe.com/aFa00j5E4ees8hf3kp2ZO00
Team $29/mo: https://buy.stripe.com/8x27sLc2s4DSapn4ot2ZO01
No waitlist. Card today.
